'''Christoph Mueller''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 3rd at [[April 2001 Munich tournament]] on 21 April 2001, according to Quirin Fürgut's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2114">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-21-munich-ralltiir-4-21-01d2114/ munich-ralltiir-4-21-01], DeckTech (Quirin "el-diablo" Fuergut, 21 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-21-munich-ralltiir-4-21-01d2114/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
